stylePrompt: Mature learner-facing educational illustration, landscape 3:2, one clear focal meaning, varied painterly or naturalist styles, no photographic or live-action impression, no in-image teaching text, logos or watermarks. Every readable face has natural features and complete hands. Avoid blank faces, chibi proportions, glossy toy rendering, realistic skin pores, stock-photo staging and readable interfaces.

items.sentenceEn: The bird's curved beak is its most notable feature.
items.sentenceZh: 这只鸟弯曲的喙是它最显著的特征。
items.scene: One adult naturalist observes one ibis in profile, with its distinctive long curved beak clearly emphasized against a simple wetland background.
items.altText: 自然观察者注视一只侧身朱鹭，其长而弯曲的喙格外突出。

items.sentenceEn: They rest in the garden during the afternoon.
items.sentenceZh: 他们下午在花园里休息。
items.scene: Exactly two adults rest in a garden after lunch under warm descending sunlight, with moderately long shadows and a cleared lunch tray indicating afternoon rather than morning or night.
items.altText: 两名成年人午餐后在花园休息，斜阳投下较长影子。

items.sentenceEn: The first train leaves at eight AM.
items.sentenceZh: 首班火车上午八点出发。
items.scene: At sunrise, one station clock clearly shows eight o'clock while one unbranded train begins leaving a quiet platform in fresh morning light.
items.altText: 晨光中的车站时钟指向八点，一列火车正驶离站台。

items.sentenceEn: They visit the outdoor market every weekend.
items.sentenceZh: 他们每个周末都逛露天市场。
items.scene: A relaxed group of three adults visits a lively outdoor craft and produce market in casual clothes, carrying reusable bags with no work equipment, under bright leisure-day sunlight.
items.altText: 三名成年人穿休闲装逛露天市集，手提购物袋享受周末时光。

items.sentenceEn: A dozen eggs fill the carton.
items.sentenceZh: 一打鸡蛋装满了蛋盒。
items.scene: Exactly twelve whole eggs fill one open carton in a perfectly clear three-by-four arrangement, all fully visible and countable.
items.altText: 打开的蛋盒中以三乘四排列着整整十二枚鸡蛋。

items.sentenceEn: The empty roof offers the possibility of a garden.
items.sentenceZh: 空屋顶提供了建造花园的可能性。
items.scene: An adult architect studies an empty flat rooftop while a soft translucent design vision shows the same roof potentially transformed into a green community garden.
items.altText: 建筑师查看空屋顶，旁边淡淡浮现其未来变成绿植花园的设想。

items.sentenceEn: Insurance helps repair the storm-damaged roof.
items.sentenceZh: 保险帮助修复被风暴损坏的屋顶。
items.scene: An adult homeowner and an adult insurance assessor examine a safely tarped storm-damaged roof while a repair crew restores shingles. The assessor holds a blank document bearing only a simple protective shield icon.
items.altText: 房主与保险查勘员查看临时遮盖的受损屋顶，维修人员正在换瓦。

items.sentenceEn: The biology department studies local plants.
items.sentenceZh: 生物系研究本地植物。
items.scene: Inside one university department, exactly five adult biologists work together on local plant specimens at shared lab benches, unified by the same research focus and workspace.
items.altText: 大学生物系的五名研究人员在同一实验室协作研究本地植物。

items.sentenceEn: Firefighters battle the advancing brush fire.
items.sentenceZh: 消防员奋力扑灭蔓延的灌木火灾。
items.scene: Exactly four adult firefighters in protective gear battle a limited brush fire from a cleared safe line using two hoses, preventing flames from reaching a nearby forest.
items.altText: 四名消防员在隔离带后用水枪对抗蔓延的灌木火。

items.sentenceEn: The first green shoot marks the beginning of spring.
items.sentenceZh: 第一株绿芽标志着春天的开始。
items.scene: One vivid green shoot pushes through the last thin patch of melting snow, with bare branches just beginning to bud around it.
items.altText: 一株鲜绿嫩芽穿过融雪，周围枝条刚刚萌芽。

items.sentenceEn: They meet for a date at the café.
items.sentenceZh: 他们在咖啡馆见面约会。
items.scene: Exactly two adults sit facing each other at a quiet café table with two cups and one small flower, showing warm mutual interest and a respectful date.
items.altText: 两名成年人在安静咖啡馆面对面坐着，友好交谈进行约会。

items.sentenceEn: The orchard is generally green, with a few yellow trees.
items.sentenceZh: 果园总体是绿色的，只有少数树变黄。
items.scene: Exactly eight orchard trees stand in one row: six are green and two are yellow, making the general condition and small exception visually clear.
items.altText: 一排八棵果树中六棵绿色、两棵黄色，整体上仍以绿色为主。

items.sentenceEn: African elephants cross the savanna.
items.sentenceZh: 非洲象穿过稀树草原。
items.scene: A family group of exactly five anatomically accurate African elephants crosses an East African savanna, with a subtle unlabeled outline of Africa incorporated into a ranger's map board.
items.altText: 五头非洲象组成家庭群穿过稀树草原，旁边地图板呈现非洲轮廓。

items.sentenceEn: He is sorry for spilling the water.
items.sentenceZh: 他为打翻水感到抱歉。
items.scene: One adult has accidentally spilled a glass of water and looks sincerely sorry while offering a towel; another adult accepts the apology calmly.
items.altText: 一人不慎打翻水后露出歉意并递上毛巾，另一人平和接受。

items.sentenceEn: A burst pipe creates a crisis in the archive.
items.sentenceZh: 爆裂水管在档案室造成危机。
items.scene: In an archive, a burst pipe sprays water while exactly three adults respond urgently: one closes the valve, one shields shelves with a waterproof sheet and one moves dry boxes to safety.
items.altText: 档案室水管爆裂，三人紧急关阀、遮盖书架并转移干燥箱件。

items.sentenceEn: She adds the final tile to complete the mosaic.
items.sentenceZh: 她放入最后一块瓷砖完成马赛克。
items.scene: One adult artist places one final colored tile into the only empty space of a large mosaic, making the pattern visibly complete.
items.altText: 艺术家把最后一块彩色瓷砖放入唯一空位，完成整幅马赛克。

items.sentenceEn: The fan cools the room.
items.sentenceZh: 风扇给房间降温。
items.scene: One safe tabletop electric fan turns toward one adult on a warm day, with lightweight ribbons streaming in the airflow and the adult visibly feeling cooler.
items.altText: 桌面电风扇吹动轻薄丝带，一名成年人感受到凉风。

items.sentenceEn: He uses a stick for balance on the trail.
items.sentenceZh: 他在小路上用木棍保持平衡。
items.scene: One adult hiker uses one simple natural wooden stick for balance while carefully stepping across a shallow rocky stream.
items.altText: 徒步者用一根天然木棍保持平衡，谨慎跨过浅溪。

items.sentenceEn: Stone edges define the garden path.
items.sentenceZh: 石质边缘清晰界定花园小路。
items.scene: Two continuous rows of pale stones clearly define both edges of a winding garden path, sharply separating the brown walkway from green planting beds.
items.altText: 两排浅色石块沿弯曲小路两侧排列，清晰界定步道与花圃。

items.sentenceEn: The wheeled dolly moves the heavy box easily.
items.sentenceZh: 带轮手推车轻松移动沉重箱子。
items.scene: One adult moves a large heavy crate easily on a stable wheeled dolly with relaxed posture, while an identical crate on the floor nearby remains difficult to move.
items.altText: 一名成年人姿态轻松地用带轮手推车移动沉重木箱。
